objective: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

description: You have brought me the book, and now it is time for your question. Are you ready?

progress: Life is full of questions, <class>. You will never be able to answer all of them, but with some time and study, perhaps you will become a little more knowledgeable.
completion: Well done, <class>. You have studied the text I asked you to, and now you have passed another of our tests.
